Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 1987
ACT V OF 1987
SIND MEDICAL COLLEGES ACT, 1987
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1)
This Act may be called the Sind Medical Colleges Act, 1987.
(2) It extends to all medical
colleges in Sind.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

Definitions

ACT V OF 1987
ACT V OF 1987
SIND MEDICAL COLLEGES ACT, 1987
2. Definitions.‑‑In this Act, unless there is
anything repugnant to the subject or context‑‑
(a) "Government"
means the Government of Sind;
(b) "medical college"
means a medical college established or maintained and run by Government and
includes a dental college;
(c) "rules" means the rules framed under this Act;
(d) "student" means a
student of a medical college.

Repeal of Sind Ordinance II of 1987

ACT V OF 1987
ACT V OF 1987
SIND MEDICAL COLLEGES ACT, 1987
4. Repeal of Sind
Ordinance II of 1987.‑‑The Sind Medical Colleges Ordinance, 1987 is
hereby repealed.
